notes: Sermon extract. Bible Characters (1902) is a multi-author compilation; the Moody section is headed 'Bible Characters described in his soul-winning sermons', and the editor's introduction says he 'culled from their utterances choice selections'. Several pieces are only a page long. No text is stated. Opening words: “Joshua was a man who walked by faith, and you will find the key to his character in three words—courage, obedience and faith. Courage, obedience and faith. And he dared …”
